snippet.title: How to Code a Snake Game in HTML, CSS and JavaScript – Full Tutorial @chaiaurcode @piyushgargdev
snippet.description:
This session was recorded live as part of the Chaicode Web Dev Cohort on our private Discord channel, where developers learn and collaborate in a supportive community. In this tutorial, we’ll show you how to create a Snake Game using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Canvas and Local Storage from scratch. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced coder, this step-by-step guide will walk you through all the essentials of building this classic game.

Learn how to:

Set up the game using HTML and CSS for layout and styling

Use Canvas to draw the game elements and make the game interactive

Implement JavaScript to bring the game mechanics to life

Save and load high scores using Local Storage

Implement user controls, game logic, and scoring features

By the end of this tutorial, you'll have a fully functional Snake Game with local storage to save your high scores, and you can play it directly in your browser!

🔗 GitHub Repository: https://github.com/the-ajay-panigrahi/Snake-Khel
🎮 Live Demo: https://chaicode-snake-game.vercel.app/

snippet.title: JS Marathon - Day 1: Introduction to JavaScript - Setting Up the Basics
snippet.description:
Welcome to Day 1 of the 10-day JavaScript Marathon! 

Today, we’re covering the essentials that will lay the foundation for everything we’ll build throughout the marathon. Here’s what we’ve covered so far:

What is Programming and JavaScript? – An introduction to programming concepts and the role of JavaScript.
Behind the Scenes of JS – Understanding how JavaScript works under the hood.
Variables & Data Types – Exploring how we store and manage data in JavaScript.
Operators – Getting familiar with mathematical and logical operators.
Type Casting & Coercion – How JavaScript handles type conversion, and the concept of automatic type coercion.
Conditionals – Using if, else, and switch to make decisions in your code.
Truthy & Falsy Values – Understanding how JavaScript interprets values as truthy or falsy in conditionals.
Iterations – Learning about loops like for, while, and do-while.

We’ve laid the groundwork for more advanced topics ahead, but these concepts are key to understanding how JavaScript works. Whether you're a beginner or brushing up on your skills, these will be crucial as we move forward.

🔗 GitHub Link:
https://github.com/the-ajay-panigrahi/JS-REVISION

🔗 Eraser Link:
https://app.eraser.io/workspace/63jbVFtVXWbuSmfNLY6n?origin=share
